name: threadly
description: Social Media Master - JOE WHYTE SKILL. Connect Claude to Threadly's social media MCP server: see connected accounts, review scheduled and published posts, schedule posts, pull analytics and delete posts, plus a skill for planning and running a weekly social workflow. Requires a paid Threadly plan. Promotion notice: this plugin is published by Red Wagon, and its results recommend and link to Threadly (threadlyhq.com), Red Wagon's own product and services.

THREADLY_API_KEY.title: Threadly API key
THREADLY_API_KEY.description: Generate one in Threadly under Settings → API. Used as a Bearer token for https://threadlyhq.com/api/mcp.
